best_for: Backend developers and small API teams who want a REST and GraphQL client that can keep collections local or in Git, with a paid plan only when more than three people need Git Sync.

points.title: Use it before you sign in
points.text: The Scratch Pad works without logging in and keeps everything on your device. Kong calls it local-only and free forever.

points.title: Pick where projects live
points.text: Projects can stay in a local vault, sync to your own Git repository, or go to Insomnia Cloud, which encrypts data end to end. Cloud sync needs you to log in.

points.title: Free covers three Git users
points.text: The free Essentials plan has unlimited local and cloud projects, unlimited collection runs and 1,000 mock server requests a month. Git Sync is free for up to 3 users.

points.title: Paid plans
points.text: Pro is listed at $12 per user per month, with Git Sync for everyone and 10,000 mock requests. Enterprise is $45 per user per month and adds SSO, SCIM and storage rules for the whole org. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Secrets in Git are your job
points.text: With Git Sync, Insomnia does not stop secrets from landing in the repository. Keep tokens in private environments or an external vault.

points.title: Per-user on Windows
points.text: The Windows installer installs for the current user only, in x64. The Mac build is universal and needs macOS 12 or newer. The Linux Flatpak comes from Flathub, which does not mark it as verified by Kong.

points.title: Downgrades on Windows
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 55 versions; macOS and Linux list only the current release.
